title: mangler Module
content_markdown: This is a module to help with SDP mangling. Note: This module is obselete and will be removed for the 1.5.0 release.
overview: This is a module to help with SDP mangling. Note: This module is obselete and will be removed for the 1.5.0 release.

exported_parameters.name: contact_flds_separator
exported_parameters.description: First char of this parameter is used as separator for encoding/decoding Contact header.
exported_parameters.notes: First char of this field must be set to a value which is not used inside username,password or other fields of contact. Otherwise it is possible for the decoding step to fail/produce wrong results.

exported_functions.name: sdp_mangle_ip

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: A pair ip/mask used to match IP's located inside SDP package in lines c=IN IP4 ip. This lines will only be mangled if located IP is in the network described by this pattern. Examples of valid patterns are “10.0.0.0/255.0.0.0” or “10.0.0.0/8” etc.

parameters.name: newip
parameters.description: the new IP to be put inside SDP package if old IP address matches pattern.

exported_functions.description: Changes IP addresses inside SDP package in lines describing connections like c=IN IP4 Currently in only changes IP4 addresses since IP6 probably will not need to traverse NAT :)

exported_functions.name: sdp_mangle_port

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: an integer which will be added/subtracted from the located port.

exported_functions.description: Changes ports inside SDP package in lines describing media like m=audio 13451.

exported_functions.name: encode_contact

parameters.name: encoding_prefix
parameters.description: Something to allow us to determine that a contact is encoded publicip--a routable IP, most probably you should put your external IP of your NAT box.

parameters.name: public_ip
parameters.description: The public IP which will be used in the encoded contact, as described by the example above.

exported_functions.description: This function will encode uri-s inside Contact header in the following manner sip:username:password@ip:port;transport=protocol goes sip:enc_pref*username*ip*port*protocol@public_ip * is the default separator.

exported_functions.name: decode_contact
exported_functions.description: This function will decode the URI in first line in packets which come with encoded URI in the following manner sip:enc_pref*username*ip*port*protocol@public_ip goes to sip:username:password@ip:port;transport=protocol It uses the default set parameter for contact encoding separator.

exported_functions.name: decode_contact_header
exported_functions.description: This function will decode URIs inside Contact header in the following manner sip:enc_pref*username*ip*port*protocol@public_ip goes to sip:username:password@ip:port;transport=protocol. It uses the default set parameter for contact encoding separator.
